title: Seasoning Addition - Credit Builder Accounts Made-Good Relief
content:
The relief share of the made-good relief on a Credit Builder account grows with the account's time open and payments credited.

## Seasoning tiers

An account open 12 months or more with 12 or more payments credited (payments posted to the account less payments returned on it) adds the seasoned addition; an account open at least 6 months with at least 6 payments credited, but either open fewer than 12 months or with fewer than 12 credited, adds the established addition; any other account adds nothing for seasoning; months open are whole calendar months from the open date, each complete on the day of the month matching the opening day or, in a month too short for that day, on the first day of the following month.

Payments credited are the number of the account's payment entries less the number of its returned-payment entries; the open date is the date the account activated.

| Months open | Payments credited | Added to the relief share |
|---|---|---|
| 12 or more | 12 or more | seasoned addition: 0.15 (15 percentage points) |
| 6 or more, with fewer than 12 months or fewer than 12 credited | 6 or more | established addition: 0.05 (5 percentage points) |
| fewer than 6 | any | nothing |
| any | fewer than 6 | nothing |

## Month-end example (hypothetical account)

An account opened 30 March has 10 whole months open on 30 January of the following year and 11 on 1 March of that year (February having no 30th day, the eleventh month completes on 1 March). With 9 payments credited it takes the established addition.
